name: Splatting for Anti-aliasing Small Cells
aliases: Anti-Aliasing for Small Cells via Splatting
definition: A technique to handle small cells that are missed by slice planes or pixel samples during scan conversion, using splatting to anti-alias and prevent loss of important details in adaptive meshes.
summary: Splatting for Anti-aliasing Small Cells renders small adaptive mesh cells as Gaussian ellipsoids to prevent detail loss, avoiding overlap with larger polygons via stencil testing.
